population: Mixed-method QLP repeat screening and follow-up of the emitting field source
period_status: Photometric recurrence of 16 primary eclipses with unequal secondary near phase 0.5
claim_basis: earlier public machine or TESS pipeline detection
prior_evidence: Kostov et al. (2025) Table 2 unvetted machine eclipse flag. ASAS-SN ROT at 3.1926 d, ZTF RSCVN at 3.1942271 d, and Gaia DR3 RS classification. Earlier work identified the variable and flagged it as an eclipse candidate.
interpretation: The two unequal narrow dip families recur on the same 3.19798973-day clock in TESS sectors 55 and 82. Difference images place both families on TIC 257808672, about 37 arcsec from the nominated TIC 257808668. The deeper dip occurs in all 16 covered predicted windows. Resolved ZTF g and r reproduce both phases at the fixed TESS ephemeris. Smooth modulation coexists with the eclipses. The tabulated depth is the median in the blended QLP aperture.
